name: Grok 4.7
description: Grok 4.7 is a rumoured successor to Grok 4.6 that Elon Musk has briefly previewed. Musk has described it as receiving additional training and targeting release within several weeks, but SpaceXAI has not published official model specifications, API availability, pricing, or a firm release date.

details.name: rumoured_release_window
details.value: Musk said on 2026-08-12 that Grok 4.7 should arrive in three to four weeks; this is not a firm release date.

page_notice.markdown: Grok 4.7 has only been briefly previewed by Elon Musk. SpaceXAI has not published official specifications, API availability, pricing, or a firm release date.

sources.notes: Musk said Grok 4.7 should arrive in three to four weeks and described additional training; this is a preview rather than an official SpaceXAI launch announcement.
Contemporaneous reporting summarizing Musk's Grok 4.7 comments.

verification.notes: The existence and tentative timing are based on Musk's preview. No official SpaceXAI model page, API listing, pricing, or release announcement is available.
